title: Leroy Bradley's band at the Club Mirador
summary: After about 18 months with Roy he joined Leroy Bradley's band at the Volpe brothers' Club Mirador in Homestead, playing supper shows.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands

blocks.x: Well, how long did you stay with Roy?
Well, a couple of -- about 18 months, I would say, because then I went to this Club Mirador in Homestead, Pennsylvania, with a band called, Leroy Bradley's Band.
This was for the Volpe brothers?
Yeah, uh-huh. We were working --
They had the place.
Yeah. This cabaret, it was called the Mirador, Club Mirador.
Did they have some beautiful looking chicks.
Oh, yes.
That waited the tables or something.
Oh, yeah. We had a show, you know. We had to play like a supper show, you know.
Yeah.
With different --
It was something like the Grand Terrace.
Yeah, with different acts and things like that.
Yeah. Yeah.
And then, well, we stayed there a couple of years.
Well, what did -- what was Bradley's instrument?
Piano.
Oh. And what was he like?
A wonderful piano player.
Really?
Oh, my God, he would just -- oh, the people would stand around the piano and cry. He would just make

them laugh. He could make them do anything. He was a genius, a wonderful man. And how I got the job was through the drummer who was studying to be a fireman. And sometimes they would call him up, you know, at the firehouse, to do a stage or something like that. Then he would call me in to take his place. And finally, well, he worked so hard at it until he became a captain, a fire captain, and then he gave me, he says, "Kenny, you got the -- you take the drums, the vibraphones, take everything, the job, it's all yours with my compliments."
